title: Becoming Xtraordinary Presented by Bear Grylls
description:
E1
Tennis legend, French Open, and Grand Slam winner Roger Federer and the world's most successful woman in Indy car racing, Danica Patrick, share their stories on becoming the best in the world.

title: Becoming Xtraordinary Presented by Bear Grylls
description:
E2
Julia Roberts relives her journey to becoming an Oscar-winning actress and Wladimir Klitschko shares how he became an Olympic gold medalist and record-breaking world heavyweight boxing champion.

title: Becoming Xtraordinary Presented by Bear Grylls
description:
E3
The world's best field hockey goalkeeper and Olympic gold medalist, Maddie Hinch, and the world's greatest living explorer, Ranulph Fiennes, share their record-breaking journeys.

title: Becoming Xtraordinary Presented by Bear Grylls
description:
E4
Bear Grylls shares his story of perseverance and how he became "the world's best known survival expert," while Ursula Burns reflects on her journey to becoming the first Black woman CEO of a Fortune 500 company.

title: Becoming Xtraordinary Presented by Bear Grylls
description:
E5
Inventor and most cited engineer in history Robert Langer and recipient of the Nobel Prize for chemistry, Frances Arnold, reflect on their award-winning careers in science.

title: Becoming Xtraordinary Presented by Bear Grylls
description:
E6
Award-winning actress and producer Courteney Cox of "Friends" recounts how she became a TV star and Channing Tatum reflects on how he went from a struggling student to a recognized Hollywood actor.

title: Becoming Xtraordinary Presented by Bear Grylls
description:
E7
The "Undisputed King of Magic" Steven Frayne AKA Dynamo and Olympic gold medalist hockey captain Kate Richardson-Walsh share their insights on success.

title: Becoming Xtraordinary Presented by Bear Grylls
description:
E8
Former president of South Africa and Nobel Peace Prize winner F.W. de Klerk and first Black woman member of the British Government and pioneering British diplomat Valerie Amos share their life lessons.

title: Becoming Xtraordinary Presented by Bear Grylls
description:
E9
Kelly Holmes reflects on how she became a double Olympic gold medalist and Tim Peake shares his journey from test pilot to the UK's first European Space Agency astronaut to stay on the International Space Station.

title: Becoming Xtraordinary Presented by Bear Grylls
description:
E10
Sabrina Cohen-Hatton, the most senior ranking firefighter in the UK, and Mark Ormrod, triple amputee and four-time Invictus Games gold medalist, share their incredible stories of resilience.

title: Amazing Dinoworld
description:
E1
The latest research indicates that feathered dinosaurs were more widespread and varied than previously thought, that they incubated their eggs and engaged in parenting.

title: Amazing Dinoworld
description:
E2
Research has made headway into the world of a gigantic "dragon" that dominated the oceans of 60 million years ago.

title: Ancient Earth: Dinosaurs of the Frozen Continent
description:
E1
The new expedition to the ice continent of Antarctica begins.

title: Ancient Earth: Dinosaurs of the Frozen Continent
description:
E2
Finding out how the great discovery in the 1990s of the Cryolophosaurus, dubbed the T. rex of Antarctica, and a 25-foot-long plant eater, the Glacialisaurus, led to a renewed interest in a continent that was once thought to be largely devoid of life.

title: Beyond the Spotlight
description:
E2
Actress Kristen Bell recounts how her nurturing nature and her good works, such as co-founding No Kid Hungry, was sparked when she was age 19 and helped deliver two babies during a missionary trip to a clinic in Brazil.

title: Beyond the Spotlight
description:
E1
Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from.".

title: Beyond the Spotlight
description:
E3
Actors/spouses Samuel and LaTanya Jackson have fought for civil rights around the globe, but their greatest satisfaction comes from handwritten thank you notes from children they have supplied with books.

title: Beyond the Spotlight
description:
E5
Inspired by his mother to be "of service," LeVar Burton entered the seminary at 13 years old; after deciding the Church didn't have the answers to his life questions, he changed his focus to theater arts and became known for Roots and Star Trek.

title: Beyond the Spotlight
description:
E6
Joe Namath grew up in Beaver Falls, Pennsylvania, near Pittsburgh. After his parents' divorce, Joe turned to sports; he was propelled into sports stardom in college and professional football earning the nickname Broadway Joe.

title: Beyond the Spotlight
description:
E4
Jimmy Donaldson, also known as MrBeast, is the world's first digital philanthropist; after becoming obsessed with YouTube at a young age, Jimmy built a viral video empire based on the joy he gets from helping others.
